raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 3, Reason for Mistake: Conflated Anthemius’s imperial title (Western Roman Emperor) with his country of origin and prematurely concluded “Italy” without verifying sources; Anthemius was from the Eastern Roman Empire (born in Constantinople), not from Italy.
